text: cortex R5 x walk: once a repair walk has reached an adjudicated-not-clean state, ending without a verified repair for any later reason (walk or step budget, no progress, early stop, refusal, block) reports that adjudication (exit 27) with its graded bytes put back and digest-checked; what ended the walk is reported as stopped_by. The label-log row is written after the R5 final check and records the exit the run exits with.
